title: Continental GT 535 Cafe (Circuit Spec)
description: Positioned for riders seeking dedicated Heritage Cafe Racer capability, the Royal Enfield Continental GT 535 Cafe (Circuit Spec) delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a balanced Upright Neutral layout, it maintains ergonomic composure across extended highway and city riding.
